# Proma Roy

> Official personal website of Proma Roy, a cybersecurity researcher and adjunct lecturer in New York City.

Proma Roy teaches computer science and applied mathematics at John Jay College of Criminal Justice and The City College of New York. Her work includes secure systems, applied cryptography, privacy-preserving technology, computing education, and equitable AI for underrepresented-language communities.

## Current teaching

- John Jay College of Criminal Justice: CSCI 171, Introduction to Python; and CSCI 271, Introduction to Computing & Programming in C++.
- The City College of New York: Applied Linear Algebra, including Python-based labs.

## Website

- [Homepage](https://promaroy.me/): Biography, academic appointments, research, technical projects, education, skills, and contact information.
- [Experience](https://promaroy.me/#experience): Current teaching appointments and prior research and professional experience.
- [Research](https://promaroy.me/#research): Research publications, presentations, and applied research.
- [Technical Projects](https://promaroy.me/#projects): Selected secure-systems, cryptography, operating-system security, and Bengali NLP projects.
- [Education](https://promaroy.me/#education): Degrees and academic background.

## Research

- [Measuring the Tokenization Premium: A Cost Audit for Underserved Language Communities](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2608.09046): Coauthored with [Avijit Roy](https://avijitroy.com/research/) and Hrishitva Patel; presented orally and as a poster at LM4UC at IJCAI 2026.
- [Tokenization Equity Audit Repository](https://github.com/HeyAvijitRoy/tea-benchmark): Reproducible benchmark and research artifacts for the tokenization study.
- [TEA Benchmark Interactive Poster](https://avijitroy.com/research/tea-benchmark/): Interactive poster for the Tokenization Equity Audit.
- [Structural Silence: When AI Infrastructure Fails Speakers of Underrepresented Languages](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2608.12278): Coauthored with [Avijit Roy](https://avijitroy.com/research/); presented as a poster at the 69th Annual International Linguistic Association Conference.
- [Structural Silence Interactive Poster](https://avijitroy.com/research/structural-silence-poster/): Interactive version of the ILA 2026 poster.

## Selected Project Repositories

- [Threshold ElGamal](https://github.com/HeyPromaRoy/Threshold-ELGamal): Threshold cryptography implementation in Rust.
- [Smart Thermostat](https://github.com/HeyPromaRoy/SmartThermostat): Secure Rust CLI with authentication, access control, hardened storage, and audit logging.

## Education

- M.S. in Cybersecurity, The City College of New York, CUNY, Grove School of Engineering (2026).
- B.S. in Computer Science & Engineering, United International University (2019).
